name: knos_pay
docs: Pay on proof: an escrow that pays a GitHub account only on a GitHub-signed token verified on chain by knos-oidc. No admin, immutable.
A native program: this file is written by hand from programs/knos_pay/src/lib.rs and checked by tests/test_idl.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding.
Every token account below is a VERIFIED GitHub Actions token account owned by knos-oidc (idl/knos_oidc.json), from a GitHub-hosted
runner, at most an hour past its expiry. What each token must say is in its audience (the aud claim):
fund knos:fund:<issue>:<amount>:<mode>:<checks hash hex>:<work secs>:<review secs>, from fund.yml;
pay knos:pay:<repository id>:<issue>:<author id>:<head sha>:<checks hash hex>:<mode>, from prove.yml;
veto knos:veto:<repository id>:<issue>, from fund.yml;
claim knos:claim:<solana address>, from a workflow_dispatch run in a repository the actor owns.
Anyone may relay Pay, Settle, Refund and Claim and pay their gas.

instructions.name: Fund
docs: A wallet escrows a bounty for one issue of one repository, pinning the repository and commit of the workflows that can prove it.

accounts.name: funder
accounts.desc: The funding wallet; pays the job's rent

accounts.name: job
accounts.desc: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, funder]

accounts.name: funderToken
accounts.desc: The funder's token account of the mint

accounts.name: vaultToken
accounts.desc: PDA ["vault", mint]: the vault's token account, created on first use

instructions.name: FundWithToken
docs: Devnet only. Mints test USDC into the vault for the job a fund token describes. One per repository per minute.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: Pays the rent of the job and the rate account

accounts.name: fundToken
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED fund token from the repository's fund.yml

accounts.name: job
accounts.desc: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, 32 zero bytes]

instructions.name: Pay
docs: A pay token from the job's pinned prove.yml proves the work. With no review window the job is paid at once: the amount less the fee
to the author's due account, the fee to the fee account. Otherwise the job becomes proven and Settle pays it after the window.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the due and rep accounts

accounts.name: due
accounts.desc: PDA ["due", author id u64 LE, mint]

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint owned by the fee owner

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The job's funder field: gets the job's rent back

instructions.name: Settle
docs: Pays a proven job after its review window.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; pays the rent of the due and rep accounts

accounts.name: due
accounts.desc: PDA ["due", author id u64 LE, mint]

accounts.name: feeToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint owned by the fee owner

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The job's funder field: gets the job's rent back

instructions.name: Veto
docs: During the review window of a proven job, the funder takes the payment back: the funding wallet signs, or a veto token is given.

accounts.name: signer
accounts.desc: The funding wallet, or anyone when a veto token is given

accounts.name: vetoToken
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED veto token from the job's pinned fund.yml; left out when the funding wallet signs

instructions.name: Refund
docs: After the deadline with no proof: the money goes back to the funder's token account (wallet-funded) or to the funder's due account (token-funded).

accounts.name: dest
accounts.desc: The funder's token account, or PDA ["due", funder id u64 LE, mint] for a token-funded job

accounts.name: rentTo
accounts.desc: The job's funder field: gets the job's rent back

instructions.name: Claim
docs: Pays everything due to a GitHub user in one mint to the address their claim token names.

accounts.name: relayer
accounts.desc: Anyone; gets the due account's rent

accounts.name: due
accounts.desc: PDA ["due", user id u64 LE, mint]

accounts.name: destToken
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint owned by the address in the token's audience

instructions.name: InitFaucet
docs: Devnet only. Creates the test-USDC mint (6 decimals); its mint authority is the program.

accounts.name: Job
docs: PDA ["job", repoId u64 LE, issue u64 LE, by]: by is the funding wallet, or 32 zero bytes for the repository's own token-funded bounty. 256 bytes.
state: 1 open, 2 proven. mode: 0 merge, 1 tests. kind: 0 funded by a wallet, 1 by a GitHub account (a fund token).
funder: the wallet that funded the job or paid its rent. wfSha: 40 lowercase hex characters.

accounts.name: Due
docs: PDA ["due", userId u64 LE, mint]: what waits for a GitHub user in one mint. 48 bytes.

accounts.name: Rep
docs: PDA ["rep", userId u64 LE]: a GitHub user's public record. 32 bytes.
repositories counts a repository each time it differs from lastRepo. vetoed is in the layout but no instruction writes it: it is 0.

accounts.name: Rate
docs: PDA ["rate", repoId u64 LE]: the last token funding of a repository (devnet). 16 bytes.
